correctness.rationale: Exact toric reconstruction from the six lattice vertices confirms that every corner chart is unimodular and has the same six monomials in local coordinates a,b. The second Hasse-principal-parts matrix has a unit 3x3 block and residual B=[[b,0,b^2],[2a,2b,4ab],[0,a,a^2]]. An independent SymPy determinant and all 9 two-minor computation gives determinant identically zero, minor ideal (a^2,ab,b^2) whenever 2 is invertible, and (ab) in characteristic 2; entries give (a,b). These are universal polynomial identities, not evaluations at sample points. Thus rank <=4 scheme is six disjoint length-three infinitesimal points in characteristic !=2 (total length 18) and the reduced union of six toric boundary components in characteristic 2; rank <=3 is the reduced six torus-fixed points in all characteristics. The torus rank is 5 and scheme boundary interpretation follows by chart overlap.
residual_risks: Independent symbolic check is exact, but the local chart-to-global smooth toric surface identification uses the standard toric gluing argument in the result.
Hasse jets, not divided ordinary derivatives in positive characteristic, are the correct evaluation map.

originality.rationale: Qualified PASS: the 2001 Lanteri–Mallavibarrena Proposition 4.3 describes precisely the same six-cubic projection, with rank five off six vertices and rank three at those vertices over the complex numbers. It does not determine scheme multiplicities or characteristic-two ranks. Perkinson 1996 gives general toric principal-parts tools; his 2000 Inflections of Toric Varieties is highly relevant but inaccessible in full after lawful route and authorized institutional attempt, so an older implicit proof cannot be excluded. The explicit all-characteristic determinantal scheme statement remains an apparent new contribution, not a novelty certificate.
residual_risks: Perkinson 2000 Inflections of Toric Varieties likely examines nearly the same toric-inflection problem; full source inaccessible, authorized Oxford VPN disconnected; possible implicit or explicit overlap.

value.rationale: This is a motivated scheme-theoretic refinement of the classical projected Togliatti example. A support/rank table is insufficient to determine local nilpotent thickness or reducedness. The exact characteristic-two degeneration changes the dimension of the natural Hasse-jet degeneracy locus from a finite length-18 scheme to a reduced anticanonical boundary cycle, while the next stratum stays reduced.
residual_risks: This precise statement does not generalize to arbitrary toric varieties or projections; that is a scope limit, not a reason to fail value.

limitations: Specific degree-six projected Togliatti surface and rank-2 Hasse jets only; no arbitrary toric embedding extension.
